cues.text: Pressing submit does not complete the task: the employer has the final review.
When Maya approves, the interface marks the work completed, and the activity timeline records the update.
From posting to applying, selecting, submitting, and approving, the task has a visible beginning and end.
This is local demonstration data, not proof of remote push delivery.
Hosted account acceptance, device testing, and a complete two-account rehearsal still matter for deployment.
The demonstration shows the intended interaction clearly, while keeping those remaining verification steps visible.
